bundle_contract.grace_clock: execution monotonic deadline; never compiler timestamp
bundle_contract.metadata: credential bundle metadata only; not a resource lifecycle ledger
bundle_contract.mode: directory 0500 and files 0400 owned by service UID; staging parent 0700
bundle_contract.mount_scope: one read-only directory per authorized reference
bundle_contract.publication: atomic rename of member files inside stable bound directory; never rename the directory
bundle_contract.retention: at most current and previous per member; remove previous after grace
bundle_contract.rotation: publish previous member plus grace metadata, then current; readers reload on bundle generation change; bounded retries on generation mismatch
